tei:div.tei:p: "$ (429)༄༅// skye med zhang rin po ches mdzad pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i lam mchog

mthar thug bzhugs so/// / (430)༄༅// dpal ldan bla ma rje btsun dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus thams cad kyi// thugs rje'i phrin las mthar thug dbang bskur ba'i// rtogs ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas// sde snod rgyud sde theg mchog mtha' dag gi /bcud kyi yang snying bde gshegs kun gyi thugs// rnal 'byor dbang phyug thugs nas thugs su brgyud// zur mtshon rtse gcig skyon bral spro bas 'god// gzhan don sbyangs stobs bdag la med mod kyi// dam chos rjes 'brangs gus pa'i blo gros can// slob mas rab bskul brtson 'grus grags pa yis// rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus skyed pa'i yum// sbyangs can skal ldan rnams kyis rtogs bya ba// rje btsun brgyud pa rnams kyi thugs kyi mdzod// lung rig man ngag ma lus theg pa'i bcud// nges don mthar phyin snying po chos kyi sku// ngo bo nyid kyis rnam dag 'od gsal dbyings// dus gsum rgyal ba byon rung ma byon rung*// 'phags pa'i tshogs kyis rtogs rung ma rtogs rung*// thub pa rnams kyis gsungs rung ma gsungs rung*// dgongs 'grel mkhan pos dkrol rung ma bkrol rung*// chos nyid (431)'od gsal spros bral rnam dag 'di// ye nas lhun grub 'phel 'grib med par gnas// nam mkha' dag la 'jig rten chags 'jig gi /me yis bsregs dang rlung gis gtor la sogs// bskal pa dpag med mang por gnod byas kyang*// mkha' la mi gnod 'phel 'grib med pa ltar// nyi 'od ye gsal sprin gyis rab bsgribs pas// mun par 'thibs dang sprin tshogs yal ba'i tshe// gsal bar gyur ba'i 'phel 'grib ltar snang gi /nyi ma'i snying po 'phel dang 'grib mi srid// de ltar gnas pa'i 'gyur med chos sku 'di// rang gi sems las ma gtogs gzhan na med// sna tshogs 'khor 'das ma lus sems la shar// rang sems ma rtogs phyin log 'khrul snang gis// dkrugs pas 'khor ba'i snod bcud sdug bsngal 'phel// rang sems nges rtogs mya ngan 'das pa yi// ye shes mtha' yas bde ba chen po shar// de phyir ma lus rang gi sems nyid las// 'phros phyir rang sems chos nyid ngo shes na// sems can kun gyi chos nyid shes par 'gyur// de shes mya ngan 'das sogs chos kun shes// chos kun yongs shes khams gsum kun las 'da'// gcig shes pas ni (432)kun la mkhas par 'gyur// rtsa ba 'gyel bas lo 'dab ngang gis 'gyel// de phyir rang sems gcig pu gtan la dbab// kun gyi sa bon rang sems gnas lugs 'di// rgyal ba sras bcas kun gyi thugs dang ni// ye nas khyad med skye med chos skur gnas// bem po ma yin rang rig rang gis gsal// dngos por ma grub mdog dbyibs tshad kyis stong*// dngos med ma yin rkyen gyis cir yang 'char// rtag par mi 'gyur ngo bo nyid kyis stong*// chad par mi 'gyur rang gsal ngo bo nyid// bdag tu ma grub brtags na snying po med// bdag med ma yin spros bral bdag nyid che// mtha' rnams ma grub 'dzin pa gang yang med// dbu mar ma grub ltos pa kun las dben// dpe yi ming dang mtshon bya'i ngos bzung med//

dpe med nam mkha' lta bu'o/ ༈ /tshig du ma grub brjod pas bsnyad du med// tshig bral ma yin brjod pa kun gyi rgyu// yod dang med dang bden dang brdzun pa dang*// stong dang mi stong zhi dang ma zhi dang*// spros pa yod dang spros pa med pa dang*// bsam du yod dang bsam gyis mi khyab dang*// bde dang sdug dang dmigs pa yod med dang*// gnyis dang gnyis med blo las 'das ma 'das// dben dang mi dben grub dang ma grub dang*// dag dang ma dag lhun gyis grub ma grub// de 'dra'i tshig tshogs brjod pas thug pa med// ji tsam zab pa'i rjod pa'i tshig tshogs kyis// rnam grangs du mar brjod par byas gyur kyang*// sems kyi gnas lugs thog tu phebs mi srid// ji tsam mkhas shing zab pa'i brtags dpyad kyis// bskal pa dpag med mang por brjod byas kyang*// rang bzhin gnyug ma brtag pa'i yul min phyir// sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa mi srid do// dper na rgya mtshor shar ba'i gza' skar de// dar tshags ji tsam bzang bas btsags byas kyang*// gza' skar dngos po dmigs su med (433)pa'i phyir// gza' skar gcig kyang zin pa mi srid do// ji srid tshig tu brjod pa de srid du// ming 'dogs ji tsam legs rung gnas lugs min// ji srid yid kyis dpyad bzod de srid du// ji tsam zab par rtogs kyang gnas lugs min// blta bya lta byed gnyis 'dzin de srid du// gnyis su med pa'i gnas lugs rtogs mi srid// mdor na yin snyam mtha' dag zhen pa'i rtsa// zhen pa'i rtsa bas 'khor ba mtha' dag spel// stong pa nyid yin snyam du 'du shes dang*// mtshan ma med dang smon pa med snyam dang*// ngos bzung med snyam rnam par dag snyam dang*// skye ba med snyam dmigs su med snyam dang*// rang bzhin med snyam spros pas dben snyam dang*// ngag dang yid dpyod yul min snyam pa dang*// ma byas lhun gyis grub pa snyam la sogs// ji tsam zab cing stong par 'du shes kyang*// rloms sems mtshan ma dag las ma g.yos pas// mtshan ma'i zhen pas phyir zhing dman par lhung*// dman pa'i las kyis rnam smin rgyun mi 'chad// 'khor gcod mi 'byin phyir zhing nad rab ldang*// blos byas lta ba mkhan gyi sgom chen rnams// phyogs 'dzin zhen pa'i nad gcod zhugs par mchis// snyam bral lhan cig skyes par mkhyen par mdzod// drang ba'i don du sgro btags tsam du zad// gnas lugs nges don 'di yin zhes bya ba// thub pas kyang ni gzigs pa yod mi srid// kho bos smras pa 'dis kyang mi dpogs te// mdzub mos zla ba mtshon pa bzhin du rtogs// de ltar shes na tha snyad tshig tshogs kyis// sgrib par mi 'gyur tshig gi skyon mi gos// de phyir tshig dang brtag dpyad mi spang zhing*// don du rlom pas zhen pa yang mi bya// de lta bu yi rang sems chos nyid de// nyon mongs rnam rtog phung po khams dang ni// skye mched la sogs sems can mtha' mnyam dang*// sa rdo rtsi shing la sogs snod kun khyab// (434)mdor na phyi nang dngos po la sogs pa// ma lus lus pa med pa kun la khyab// khyab kyang khyab bya khyab byed gnyis su med// bdag nyid chen po gcig gi cho 'phrul yin// rgya mtshor shar ba'i gza' skar thams cad la// rgya mtshos khyab mod gnyis su dbyer mi phyed// chu nyid 'khyams pa'i rba rlabs thams cad la// chu yis khyab mod ji ltar dbye ru med// bar snang dag la smig rgyu g.yo ba la// bar snang dag gis khyab mod dbyer mi phyed// gser las byas pa'i sku dang rgyan la sogs// gser gyis khyab mod ji ltar dbyer mi phyed// bu ram las byas 'gro drug gzugs brnyan la// bu ram dag gis khyab ste dbyer mi phyed// 'ja' tshon dag las nam mkha' logs na med// nam mkha' las kyang gzha' tshon gzhan na min// gzha' tshon nam mkha' mkha' nyid gzha' tshon no// tha dad ma yin dbyer med bcad du med// de bzhin sems dang sna tshogs dbyer mi phyed// sems dang stong pa mi phyed stong pa dang*// bde ba mi phyed chen po mnyam pa nyid// de bzhin srid dang myang 'das dbyer mi phyed// de ltar khyab pa'i sems nyid phyag rgya che// rang bzhin stong pas cir yang ngos bzung med// mtshan nyid rig pa'i cho 'phrul cir yang gsal// ngo bo dbyer med zung 'jug rdo rje sems// zad med stor med rlag med sus kyang ni// 'phrog par mi nus nam mkha' mdzod kyi sems// dri mas ma gos shel ltar dag pa'i sems// rang rig rang gsal mar me lta bu'i sems// rang bzhin 'od gsal byang chub snying po'i sems// rgyun chad med pa chu bo lta bu'i sems// ngos bzung med pa bar snang lta bu'i sems// phyi nang med pa ye shes zang thal sems// 'khar gzhong gtsang ma chu yis bkang ba 'dra// bag chags gzugs brnyan ma lus 'tshar ba'i sems// me long g.ya' med phyis pa'i ngos dang 'dra//

lta ba'i le'u'o/ ༈ /de ltar gnas pa'i rang sems gnyug (435)ma de// ma rtogs log par rtog pa'i rkyen dbang gis// bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa'i sgro btags nas// phyin ci log pa'i mthu yis nyon mongs dang*// rnam par rtog pa'i tshogs rnams rab tu 'phel// de yis las bsags las kyi rnam smin gyis// 'khor ba'i chu bo mi bzad rba klong du// skye shi la sogs sdug bsngal mi bzad pas// g.yengs shing g.yengs shing rgyun chad med par mnan// 'gro ba rigs drug snang ba sna tshogs la// log par mthong ba'i bag chags sna tshogs kyis// sems la tshang byas rnam par rtog pa spel// phyin ci log gi spyod ngan sna tshogs kyis// bzod glags med pa'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs la// rgyun chad med par yang dang yang du myong*// myong ba nyid kyis gti mug phyir phyir 'phel// ma go lus kyis 'dod chags khong khro dang*// nga rgyal zhe 'dod ser sna la sogs kyis// rang sems yang nas yang du dkrugs par byed// kye ma 'khor ba 'di la su yid gtod// rang sems gnyug ma'i gnas lugs rtogs gyur na// log par rtog pa'i mun pa sangs par 'gyur// bdag 'dzin nyon mongs zhen pa las grol te// las dang sdug bsngal kun las nges par thar// ye nas gnas pa'i chos sku mngon du gyur// smon lam 'phel bas gzhan don 'bad med 'grub// rgyu bde lam bde 'bras bu'i dus su bde// mya ngan 'das pa'i rten 'brel dang re spro// rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bur sdug bsngal ba'i// khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal zhe re 'jigs// des na 'khor ba'i 'dam las bros nas ni// mya ngan 'das pa'i skam sar cis ma bsnyag /mya ngan 'das pa'i chos la gang spro des// dang por chos la zhugs ma thag nas kyang*// dad pa dge ba'i phyogs su blo song bas// bzhin mdog ngan yang kun gyi yid 'ong na// bzhin ldan chos la zhugs rnams smos ci dgos// snyan grags spangs kyang kun gyis (436)snyan pa sgrog

/bkur bsti spangs kyang kun gyis bkur bsti byed// dma' sa bzung yang kun gyis gong du 'khur// sdug bsngal bsgrubs kyang mi tshe skyid la skyel// dbul por gyur kyang longs spyod yo lang byed// lto gos 'bad pa med par shugs la 'byung*// gcig pur bros kyang 'khor slob tshogs dang 'phrad// skrod pa med kyang log 'dren bgegs rnams 'bros// bos pa med kyang lha dang chos skyong 'du// chags sdang nga rgyal sogs kyis kun bslangs nas// khram zol g.yo sgyu gtso bor spyad byas kyang*// thos pa la sogs yon tan dam dum kun// chud mi za bar yon tan tshod ka la// longs spyod byed pa rnams la mngon sum gzigs// nga rgyal la sogs nyon mongs mnyam po la// thos pa bag tsam byas des mi chen byed// dge ba'i gzugs brnyan dam dum spyod pa kun// yon tan dam dum kun kyang mi slu na// dam chos gsha' mar spyod rnams smos ci dgos// bdag po med pa'i ri brag lung stong na// tshul 'chos med pa'i spyod pa bag re yangs// mi dran med pa'i skyid sha a re mnog /'phya ltos med pa'i ri dwags 'grogs re bde// tshul khrims gtsang ma'i zas gos dro la mdzes// ma chags chog shes nor rdzas zad pa med// bzod pa'i go cha 'thug cing sra la yang*// shugs kyis mgyogs pa'i brtson 'grus rta re bzang*// byin can bla ma dkon mchog skyabs re bzang*// thabs lam gnad kyi gdams ngag nyams re dga'// bde gsal mi rtog ting 'dzin zhe re zhim// rang rig dri med stong pa 'od re gsal// gzhi med cir yang 'char ba rgod re bro// gang shar dbyings la ma g.yos blo re bde// nyams myong bdud rtsis tshims pas kha re ngoms// spros bral nang nas shar bas sems re gtsang*// rtog pa'i rang bzhin shes pas thag re chod// rig pa'i mdzod la dbang phyug zhe re phyug /snang srid chos skur longs spyod a re skyid// snang (437)grags kha la sgyur bas dbang re che// log rtog bdud dmag thul bas kha re drag

/'khor ba'i dong nas then pas pho re shor// 'gro don shug kyis 'grub pas phan re che// bde chen thang la rgyug pas bang re mgyogs// de sogs sgrub la brtson pa'i yon tan rnams// bskal par brjod kyang zad med brjod mi lang*// sgrub la brtson pa'i yon tan de 'dra na// drod rtags thob pa'i yon tan smos ci dgos// rdzu 'phrul stobs dang mngon shes la sogs pa'i// yon tan bskal par brjod kyang thug pa med// drod rtags thob pa'i yon tan de 'dra na// sku gsum mngon gyur yon tan smos ci dgos// bla med ye shes bsam yas la sogs pa'i// rgyal ba'i yon tan brjod pas zad mi srid// 'khor 'das so mtshams shan dbye ba'i le'u'o/ ༈ /ji tsam tshig la mno zhing dpyod mkhas kyang*// nyams su ma blangs nang nas ma shar bas// blo yi brtags pas gnas lugs rtogs mi srid// gnas lugs ma rtogs bag chags 'byong mi srid// de phyir tshig dang rtog ge'i shes rab la// ma zhen bla ma'i gdams ngag nyams su long*// ne tsho'i 'don pa sag shi'i glur song nas// bdag gzhan ma mthong g.yang sar lhung nyen gda'// dam pa'i gdams ngag nyams su blang ba'i tshe// lus dang srog la ma chags bya ba thong*// ltog 'khyags na'am mu ges shi yang bla'i// thams cad rmi lam yin gyis bor la thob// kun gyis brnyas dang grags ngan phog kyang rung*// dman sa bzung la sgrub pa snying por 'bungs// 'jig rten bya ba ma thengs pa yi rgyu// 'khyags grir ltogs grir shi yi dogs pas lan// sprang ban zhang gi yon tan bag tsam 'di// lus srog 'ben du btsugs pa'i bka' drin lags// nor rdzas khab skud yan chad spangs gyur kyang*// 'tsho ba'i sems khral byed na spangs pa min// nga mi 'dod kyi bsam pa ma spangs na// 'jig rten bya ba (438)thongs pa'i dus mi mchi// 'jig rten mtha' dag blo yis ma btang na// gtong phod byas dang tshul khrims bsrungs pa dang*// bla ma mchod dang dben pa bsten pa dang*// bsam gtan 'bad dang nyams myong bzang snyam dang*// shes rab che dang rtogs pa mtho la sogs// dge sbyor ci byas ngal ba don med yin// 'jig rten blo yis gtong ba ma go na// lha mi'i bde skyid la yang mi bsam na// tshe 'di'i skyid sdug bsam pa smos ci 'tshal// ji srid rnam rtog ma zad bar du ni// sang bya gnang bya'i brel ba shor me srid// lings kyis bor la dam pa'i phyag phyir 'breng*// gdams pa'i mdzod la rang bun tshud pa dang*// phyi nang bdud kyi dpung gis mi tshugs dang*// tshul khrims gtsang ma ngo lkog med la sogs// chig rkya thub nas gcig pur ri khrod 'grim// tshul 'chos med pa'i tshul khrims gtsang ldan pas// zhen 'khris nye ring med pa'i phan sems kyis// 'gro ba'i don du byang chub sems bskyed de// thang lhod med pa'i sgrub pa gsha' mar 'bad// tsha grang bkres skom srog gi bar chad sogs// snyan grags zang zing phyogs su ma shor bar// ji ltar gsungs pa'i gdams ngag nyams su blang*//

bya ba btang ba'i le'u'o/ ༈ /sems can shes pa bsam yas shing*// dbang po'i bye brag bsam mi khyab// sbyangs pa che chung khyad par gyis// rgyal ba'i thog mtha' zad pa med// mdor bsdus gdams ngag rnam pa gsum// sbyangs pa che chung khyad par gyis// rim gyis pa dang gcig char dang*// thod rgal ba yi gang zag go /rim gyis pa yi lam mchog de// gcig char ba yi chos log yin// gcig char ba yi lam mchog de// rim gyis pa yi chos log yin// rma bya'i zas mchog btsan dug yin// gzhan gyis zos na 'chi bar 'gyur// nya yi gnas mchog chu yin te// mi sogs chu yis subs nas 'chi// nya ni skam la phyung na 'chi// tshad pa'i nad la gang phan de// (439)grang ba'i nad la gnod par 'gyur// grang ba'i nad la gang phan de// tshad pa'i nad la shin tu gnod// gang zag gcig la'ang gnas skabs kyi// snga phyi'i theg pa so sor bstan// dman pa'i dus su gang phan de// mchog gi dus su 'ching bar byed// mchog gi dus su gang phan de// dman pa'i dus su ltung bar byed// tshad pa'i nad gzhi gcig pa la// zhugs ma thag tu bsil thang phan// sos la khad la shin tu gnod// de phyir gnas skabs dus tshod dang*// dbang po mtho dman shes byas la// phan tshun lam la smad mi bya// rim gyis pa yi gang zag gis// dang po dal 'byor rnyed dka' bas// ngan 'gro'i 'jigs la skyo ba bskyed// dal 'byor mi rtag bsam byas la// myur du gsum la skyabs 'gro bya// de rjes bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad// de rjes bsam gtan khrims lnga dang*// dge tshul dge slong khrims kyi bslab// 'khor ba'i chos la yid phyung nas// mya ngan 'das la blo brtan cing*// nges par 'byung ba'i khrims ldan pas// bye brag mdo sde'i grub mtha' slobs// de rjes dman pa'i byang chub de// spang phyir 'gro ba'i drin lan bsam// byams dang snying rje goms pa yis// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas// sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyis// zin pa'i phar phyin drug dang ni// tshogs gnyis dag tu bsdus byas la// stong nyid snying rje zung 'brel las// zhi gnas lhag mthong goms bya zhing*// rang rgyud legs par sbyang bar bya// rang 'dod med pa'i phan sems kyis// rgyun chad med pa'i gzhan don 'bad// de ltar sbyangs pa'i skyes bu yis// yan lag bdun ldan sku sgrub phyir// rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs te// rgyud sde bzhi la rim gyis slobs// de rjes rnal 'byor bla med kyi// rgyud du bum pa'i dbang sogs la// dam tshig gtsang mar bsrung ldan pas// bskyed pa'i rim pas sbyang bar bya// de rjes gsang ba'i dbang dag gis// rtsa rlung (440)rtsol ba bdag byin rlobs// de rjes gsum pa'i bde stong sgoms// bzhi pa mthar thug goms par bya// rim gyis gang zag zur tsam smos// gang zag rigs ni brjod mi lang*// theg pa mas 'dzeg dgos pa yod// che long slob pas chog pa yod// slob mi dgos pa dag kyang yod// dbang ma bskur bar thob pa yod// bskur yang ma thob shin tu mang*// bskur na thob la ma bskur na// mi thob pa yi rigs kyang yod// ye nas dbang dang ldan pa'ang yod// de ltar snod kyi rigs shes nas// snod dang 'tshams pa'i lag len bya//

rim gyis pa'i lam dang gang zag gi rigs bstan pa'i le'u'o/ ༈ /dam chos rjes 'brang gus pa'i blo gros can// slob mas rab bskul brtson 'grus grags pa yis// gal te phan pa srid mtha' mi khegs snyam// sbyangs can skal ldan rnams kyi rtogs byar bkod// gcig char ba yi gang zag gis// lus sogs dngos po ci yod kyis// brgyud ldan bla ma mnyes par bya// dbang ngam byin rlabs ldan pa yi// byang chub sems kyis rab 'phangs la// thog ma nyid nas nges pa'i don// phyag rgya chen po bsgom par bya// rtogs pa'i bcud ldan bla ma yis// rang la yod pa'i ye shes de// lag pa'i gter bzhin ngo sprod la// bsgom bya sgom byed med mod kyi// sgom med ngang las yengs mi bya// spras spros mang po'i zhi 'dod kyis// lhun grub ye shes sgrib bar mchis// phyag rgya chen po sgom pa la// 'di bya'i tig po mi dgos so// sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyi// go rim med cing grangs nges med// dus tshod tshes grangs brtsi mi dgos// nam dran 'drogs la glod la zhog /dang po bar dang tha ma med// rang sems skye med rgyun mi 'chad// chu rlabs rnyogs pa'i lang long de// ma rnyogs rang sar bzhag na dwangs// rang sems rtog pa'i sgrib g.yogs 'di// ma bcos rang bzhag chos skur dwangs// bcas bcos ma byed glod la zhog /shes pa ma bkug yan (441)par thong*// zhe 'dod ma byed phyal sar zhog /dmigs gtad ma 'cha' tal bar thong*// bya byed ma mang tsen ne zhog /sems kyi bzhag sa ma 'tshol bar// rten med bar snang lta bur grol// 'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar la// mi bsam shes pa rang sar zhog /rnam rtog 'phros rung ma 'phros rung*// ched du ma sgoms lhug par zhog /mdor na ci yang ma sgoms par// shes pa ci dgar thod la thong*// gang la'ang nyam nga bya mi dgos// chos sku'i ngang las g.yos ri shi// shes pa lhod kyis glod tsam na// gsal la rtog pa med pa'i nyams// bar snang dag pa'i dkyil 'khor gnas// de ni 'od gsal chos sku yin// de ltar bzhag pa'i ngang nyid las// rnam rtog tal gyis byung ba de// de nyid 'od gsal chos sku las// gzhan zhig yin snyam ma sems shig

/g.yo med rgya mtsho dwangs pa la// rba rlabs chil gyis langs pa de// gzhan zhig min pa ji bzhin du// rtog pa'i gzhi ma sems yin la// sems kyi mtshan nyid gsal rig yin// gsal rig rang bzhin stong pa ste// stong pa'i ngo bo bde chen yin// sems kyi rang bzhin de la ni// mtshan ma'i mun pa gtan med pas// 'od gsal bya ba ming du btags// chos rnams kun gyi bdag nyid de// rang sems rig pa'i ngo bo yin// rang sems rig pa'i ngo bo de// mtshan ma'i lus kyis stong pas na// lus med lus te lus kyi mchog /lus med chos nyid lus yin phyir// chos kyi sku zhes btags pa yin// phyi ru rnam rtog 'phros pa de// chos sku las ni chos sku 'phro// zung 'jug las ni zung 'jug 'phro// chos dbyings las ni chos dbyings 'phro// rnam dag las ni rnam dag 'phro// rdo rje sems las rdor sems 'phro// byang chub sems las byang chub 'phro// gdams ngag gsha' mas ma zin cing*// sbyangs pa'i 'phro med rmongs pa'i mis// 'phros pa dang ni ma 'phros pa// rtog pa dang ni mi rtog dang*// (442)sems dang chos sku gnyis su phye// rnam rtog skyon du bltas shing bkag /mi rtog 'dod cing ched du sgrub// chu rlabs phyags pas phyir mi 'khyongs// rtog pa bkag pa'i mi rtog pa// de nyid rnam rtog 'khrul pa ste// chos skur sgrib pa'i mun chen yin// rtog pa 'phro bar mi 'dod gang*// mi rtog gnas par 'dod pa yin// zhe 'dod 'gong po phugs su zhugs// gnyug ma'i skor mdzod zad par byed// rnam rtog 'gegs pa'i sgom chen de// mar 'dod chu la bsrub pa bzhin// bskal par bsgoms kyang don mi mthong*// de phyir rnam rtog dgag mi dgos// 'dug na ched du spro mi dgos// 'phros kyang chos sku 'dug kyang ni// chos sku'i ngang las g.yos pa med// bla ma dam pas zin gyur na// 'phros kyang grol la 'dug kyang grol// bla ma dam pas ma zin na// 'phros kyang 'ching la 'dug kyang 'ching*// de phyir gdams pas zin par mdzod// grogs su 'char bar gdon mi za// brtag dpyad tsab tsub ma mang bar// lhod kyis glod la tsen gyis zhog

/phyi log rjes su ma 'brang bar// shes pa ci dgar thod la thong*// phyi rol yul la ma lta zhig /rang gi sems la'ang ma lta zhig /lus kyang stong la sems kyang stong*// nyam nga bag tsha bya mi dgos// 'di yin snyam pa gang byung yang*// dmigs zhen sa bon thebs pa yin// rloms sems myu gu skyes gyur na// 'khor ba'i sdong po 'phel bar mchi'o// sems nyid ye dag 'od gsal la// sgom pa'i mun pas ma sgribs shig /rtsol med 'bras bu stor bar mchi'o// sems nyid rgya mtsho dwangs pa la// zhe 'dod rnyogs pa ma slongs shig /chos sku'i nor bu sgrib par mchi'o// sems nyid me long g.ya' med la// bsam gtan dri mas ma byugs shig /ye shes gzugs brnyan mi mthong ngo*// sems nyid nor bu rin chen 'di// mtshan ma'i 'jims sa ma gtums shig /'bras bu dgos 'dod 'gags par mchi'o// mdor na yin snyam med par zhog /ma yin snyam pa med par (443)zhog /yin snyam sems dang min snyam sems// phan tshun ltos pa'i 'dzin pa yin// 'dzin pa gang yang med pas na// ma yin pa ni gang yang med// mnyam bral ngang du phyam gyis thong*// bzhag dang mi bzhag mi bsam zhing*// btang dang mi btang yang mi bsam// bsam dang mi bsam yang mi bsam// 'gro'am 'dug gam 'greng yang rung*// sgom mam nyal lam za yang rung*// cal col smra dang nyal la sogs// gnyug ma'i yid kyis zin pa gces// bzhag thabs kyi le'u'o/ ༈ /rang sems lhun grub chos sku 'di// ma bcos rang gar bzhag pa las// nyams kyi khyad par nges par 'char// rim gyis pa dang thod rgal ba// gcig char ba dang gsum du 'dod// rim gyis pa yi 'char lugs ni// dang po gnas pa tsam du 'byung*// de nas nyams myong nges par 'char// de rjes rtogs pa lhag gis 'char// gnas pa dang po byung dus su// ri gzar 'o gsal rbab 'gril bzhin// rnam rtog zar ma chad par ldang*// sgom skal med dam snyam pa 'ong*// rnam rtog byung tshad tshor ba de// shes pa cung zad gnas pa yin// gnas pa med pa'i gong rol du// rnam rtog rang gar shor ba yin// rtog pa 'gyus kyang ngo ma shes// de nas dal 'bab chu bo bzhin// shes pa dal zhing rnam rtog nyung*// de nas rgya mtsho'i gzhi bzhin du// shes pa mi g.yo brtan par gnas// de nas nyams su myong ba 'char// bar snang dag pa'i dkyil bzhin du// gsal la mi rtog bde ba myong*// mar me rlung gis ma bskyod bzhin// rang gi rang gsal yengs pa med// me tog mdzes pa char bab bzhin// gsal le hrig ge yal le ba// sprin med mkha' la nyi shar bzhin// sing nge phyal le dngos po med// mkhar phor chu yis gang ba bzhin// phyi nang med par sang nge ba// de 'dra'i ming la thug pa med// gzhi med rmi lam lta bur 'char// (444)dngos med 'ja' tshon lta bur 'char// 'dzin med chu zla lta bur 'char// nam mkha'i 'dod yon longs spyod bzhin// ci yang myong ba med par myong*// ma myong ba ni myong ba'i mchog

/myong ba thams cad bral te 'gro// ma myong ba la 'bral rgyu med// nyams myong gi le'u'o/ ༈ /de ltar nyams su myong gyur nas// rtogs pa'i ye shes lhag gis 'char// rtogs pa'i ye shes ma shar na// nyams myong ji ltar bzang gyur kyang*// shing bcad rtsa ba ma phyin no// phyir zhing nyon mongs zur bu 'phel// de phyir rtogs pa shar ba gces// rtogs pa'i ye shes 'char ba de// a re 'dod kyis 'char ba min// brtags dpyad mkhas pas 'ong ba min// thos pa che bas 'ong ba min// rtog ge ba yi spyod yul min// rtog pa bkag pa'i mi rtog pa// ji tsam 'thug cing tshan che yang*// ye shes skye ba'i sgrib chen yin// rtog pa'i ye shes shugs 'byung de// a re 'dod dang glod pa dang*// brtag dpyad mkhas dang mi mkhas dang*// thos pa che dang chung ba dang*// nyams myong bzang dang ngan pa dang*// rtsol ba drag dang zhan la sogs// gang gis kyang ni mi 'char ste// bla ma'i dus thabs bsten pa dang*// bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya// bla ma'i dus thabs bsten zhes pa// rtogs ldan bla ma mnyes pa yi// byin rlabs stobs kyis 'char ba yin// bdag gi bsod nams zhes pa ni// sbyangs pa'i 'phro can rnams la 'char// de phyir rtogs pa'i ye shes de// byin rlabs lam la gnas pa'i phyir// dad pa can gyi spyod yul yin// gus pa can la 'char ba yin// sbyangs pa can gyis rtogs pa yin// kun gyi grogs ni brtson 'grus yin// skal ldan dbang po rab kyis mthong*// tshig mkhan rnams kyi blor mi shong*// de 'dra'i gang zag rtog ldan la// gnyis med rtogs pa 'char ba de// bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs kyis// rtog pa'i dkyil nas chos sku mched// sems nyid dkyil nas gnyis med 'char// nyon mongs dkyil nas ye (445)shes 'char// nyams myong dkyil nas rtogs pa 'char// gnyid log skyes bu sad pa bzhin// gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa sangs kyis song*// gnyis med ye shes sprad kyis sad// 'a pa de tsugs 'dug pa la// snga na ma rtogs rdug song snyam// gnyis med ye shes a re dga'// sngan chad spyod pa ngo re tsha// rtogs dang ma rtogs zer ba yi// 'khor 'das so mtshams de ru phyed// sngan chad ma rtogs gong rol du// dper na mi zhig gnyid log pa'i// rmi lam rmis pa'i dus tsam na// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khyams pa rmis// dmyal sogs sdug bsngal myong ba rmis// sun pas bla ma bsten pa rmis// gdams ngag nyams su blangs pa rmis// nyams myong sems la shar ba rmis// 'od gsal chos sku shar ba rmis// rtogs pa'i mun nag sangs pa rmis// mnyam bzhag rjes thob med pa rmis// de nas rtogs pa shar ba rmis// ma rtogs pa yi sems can la// dmigs med snying rje shar ba rmis// phyag rgya chen po mchog thob nas// gzugs skus 'gro don lhun grub rmis// gnyid med sprad de sad dus su// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal myong ba med// sun pas bla ma bsten pa med// gdams ngag nyams su blangs pa med// nyams myong sems la shar ba med// 'od gsal chos skur shar ba med// rnam rtog mun nag sangs pa med// mi rtog pa la gnas pa med// ye shes rtogs pa shar ba med// sems can med cing snying rje med// byang chub med cing thob pa med// 'gro ba med cing don byed med// bden pa med cing rdzun pa med// rmi lam snang ba tsam du zad// rmi lam rmis pa'i 'khor ba de// ga nas byung zhing gang du song*// 'khor spangs mya ngan 'das pa de// ga nas byung zhing gang du song*// de sogs rmi lam chos rnams kun// ga nas byung zhing gang du song*// dper na rgyal po chen po zhig

/gdan las skad cig ma bskyod par// sgyu ma'i rta phos khyer ba de// la dgu lung dgu brgal (446)ba dang*// bde sdug sna tshogs nyams myong zhing*// lo zla mang po lon mod kyang*// rgyal pos gdan las ma g.yos shing*// snga dro tsam yang lon pa med// rtogs pa de ltar shar ba yi// shes rab chen po'i skad cig la// chos kun ma lus khong du chud// chud do snyam pa'i rlom sems med// gnyis med ye shes mngon du gyur// gyur snyam du yang rlom sems med// khams gsum theg pa dman las grol// grol snyam du yang rlom sems med// gnyis med rtogs pa'i skad cig la// snang grags sems su thag chod pas// rnam bcas grub mtha' mngon du gyur// sems nyid gsal bar thag chod pas// rnam med grub mtha' mngon du gyur// rang rig sgyu ma ltar shes pas// sgyu mar smra ba'i grub mtha' rdzogs// sgyu ma stong par shes pa yis// rab tu mi gnas grub mtha' rdzogs// stong pa snying rjer shar ba yi// gnyis med zung 'jug lta ba rdzogs// zung 'jug yid la mi byed pas// phyag rgya chen po mngon du gyur// gyur snyam du yang 'du shes med// de ltar rtogs pa'i ye shes de// gang nas kyang ni ma 'ongs la// gang du yang ni mi 'gro ste// gar yang gnas pa med pa'o// rtogs bya rtogs pa'i ye shes gnyis// mi rtog chos kyi dbyings su thim// dbyings las 'du shes rlom pa med// mkha' ltar mnyam pa nyid la gnas// smra bsam thams cad 'char ba'i rgyu// yang dag nyid la yang dag blta// yang dag mthong na rnam par grol// nga yis rtsed mo byas pa la// byis pa thams cad a thang chad// yod na bla ma rje btsun mchod// med na shes pa glod la nyol// de tshe rim gyis 'char lugs yin// thod rgal ba yi gang zag gi /gnas pa nyams myong rtogs pa gsum// sngon du rtogs pa lhag gi 'char// rtogs kyang mi brtan rba rlabs 'dra// res 'ga' nyams myong res 'ga' ni// gnas pa 'ong ste nges pa med// nyams kyi mtho dma' skas kha'i rtsal// (447)gcig char ba yi gang zag la// rtogs pa'i bcud ldan bla ma yis// gdams ngag bstan ma thog tu yang*// nyams myong rtogs pa gnas pa gsum// sgom long med par dus gcig 'char// nyams myong 'phel 'grib yod gyur kyang*// rtogs pa 'gyur ba med par gnas// spre'u yar rgyug mar rgyug kyang*// ljon shing 'gyur ba med par gnas// rba rlabs zhi rung ma zhi rung*// rgya mtsho'i gting la 'gyur ba med// rang sems chos sku lhun grub la// nyams myong khyod rang gang dgar song*// nyams kyi myang 'das gsal bar bas// rtogs pa nyams dang ma 'brel na// rlung dmar gseb kyi mar me bzhin// dang po'i las can phung bar mchi'o// brtan pa thob pa'i sgom chen la// bzang rung ngan rung grogs su 'char// dang po pa rnams ma 'gran cig

/sgron me chung ngu'i dus su ni// bser bu phra mo tsam yang gnod// nags la me chen 'bar ba'i tshe// rlung dmar che yang grogs su 'gyur// rtog pa nyag nyug shar gyur kyang*// brtan pa ma thob sgom chen rnams// nyams su myong ba'i shing skam gyis// rtogs pa'i sgron me gso ba gces// shing rlon mang na bsad par mchi'o// rtogs pa ji ltar mtho gyur kyang*// gnas pa nyams myong ma brtan na// sems la rang dbang ma thob na// nyon mongs dgra bos bcings par mchi'o// ji ltar skyes bu gces pa zhig /dgras bzung mtshon chas gtams gyur na// rang khyim lam ngo cha yod kyang*// 'gro dbang med pa ji bzhin no// de phyir nyams myong brtan po yis// rtogs pa'i sgron me gso bar gces// sems la rang dbang ma thob na// rtogs pa'i gter dang bral bar mchi'o// smra kham che ba'i kha na med// gzabs kyin mdzod cig sgom chen rnams// kha tsho nyams dang 'gal bar mchi'o// gnyis med rtogs pa'i le'u'o/ ༈ /phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor pas// rtogs pa'i (448)yid bzhin nor bu la// nyams su myang bas mdog phyung ste// spyod pa'i nus pas dgos 'dod skong*// rim gyis pa yi gang zag ni// gsang sngags lam la zhugs ma thag /mi dge'i bsam pa thag bsrings la// 'khor ba'i chos la yid phyungs te// byang chub chen por blo brtan pas// rang 'dod med pa'i bsam pa yis// 'gro ba'i don du sems bskyed la// lha yi nga rgyal ma bral bas// bzlas brjod maṇḍal gtor ma dang*// mchod sogs yan lag bdun pa dang*// yi dwags rnams la gtor ma dang*// chu sbyin klu rnams gso ba dang*// yod na bla ma mnyes par bya// dge 'dun ston mo tshogs 'khor dang*// slong ba kun la phongs med sbyin// phyi dang nang gi sbyin sreg bya// tshwa tshwa mchod rten sku gzugs bzhengs// srog chags tshe bskyab gsung rab bklag /mdor na bskyed rdzogs thun bar du// snying rje chen pos kun bslangs nas// dge ba 'ba' zhig ma gtogs pa// lung ma bstan du'ang mi bsdad na// mi dge'i spyod pa smos ci dgos// shin tu btsun pa'i dge slong ma// bag ma gsar pa'i tshul bzung nas// spyod lam bag dang ldan pa yis// byed dgu dge ba'i chos dang bstun// phyi nang sgrib pa sbyang bya zhing*// bsod nams gsog la 'bad par bya// yon tan gsang la lkog tu spel// las 'bras khyad du gang gsod des// kun rdzob thabs la skur ba 'debs// 'dab gshog bral ba'i bya bzhin du// ngan 'gro'i g.yang sar nges par lhung*// de phyir mi dge phra nas spang*// dge ba phra nas bsgrub par bya// de ltar dge ba'i sbyor ba la// rgyun mi 'chad par brtson ldan pas// cung zad brtan pa thob gyur nas// spyod pa phyi nang gnyis su phye// tshogs spyod skye bo rnams dang bstun// dben pa nang spyod ting 'dzin spel// nang spyod ting 'dzin spel ba'i tshe// dang po'i las bas ma tshor bar// ting 'dzin rtogs pa gong 'phel ba'i// spyod pa nyams dang bstun cing bya// mi 'chi bcu (449)phyed spyad bya zhing*// stobs lnga dag kyang bsten par bya// 'dod yon bcu phyed mi spang zhing*// zhen pa spangs la grogs su khyer// zhing sa'i 'bras kyi myu gu de// chu lud 'dzom pas rgyas par byed// rnal 'byor ye shes myu gu de// 'dod yon bsten pas rgyas par byed// skye med nyams dang ma bral bas// gang la'ang zhen pa med par spyod// tshogs spyod rang spyod lhug pa yi// gnyis med rtogs pas zin byas la// 'di bya 'di mi bya med par// spyod pa gang dgar btang bar bya// gnyis med rtogs pa'i nyams myong gis// gos la 'di gon mi gon med// bzang rung ngan rung bgo bar bya// zas la 'di za 'di mi za med// gtsang rung rtsog rung bza' bar bya// mi rtog ye shes 'phel bar 'gyur// ngag la 'di smra 'di mi smra med// bla brdol lta bur smra bar bya// gang la'ang ched du bcos mi bya// rang byung lhug par gnas par bya// chos sku'i nyams dang 'bral mi bya// gang la'ang zhen pa med par bya// rang gi 'khor ram gzhan dag gis// legs nyes la sogs ci byas kyang*// skad cig tsam yang 'khrugs mi bya// bem po bzhin du gnas par bya// sems la gnod pa'i bya ba rnams// nam du yang ni mi bya'o// ri dwags mi la 'bros pa bzhin// rtag tu mi la 'bros par bya// bdag bzang snyems pas gzhan dag la// kho bzang kho ngan bshad mi byed// khram pas rang mtshang sbed pa bzhin// rang gi yon tan rtag tu sba// mi chen 'dir dga' mi bya zhing*// rtag tu dman sa bzung bar bya// mtho dma' med pa'i don rtogs kyang*// bla ma mkha' 'gro rtag tu mchod// mdor na rang 'dod g.yo sgyu dang*// bcos ma thams cad spang bar bya// ji srid mnyam bzhag rjes thob gnyis// yod pa de srid mnyam bzhag la// shes pa brtan nam mi brtan brtag

/mnyam bzhag shes pa mi brtan na// mag ma mog mas mgo gtums nas// blun sgom byas pas (450)don go med// byams dang snying rjes kun bslangs nas// lus ngag dge la 'bad par bya// 'on te mnyam bzhag brtan gyur na// lus ngag dge sbyor gang yang bla'i// mnyam bzhag 'ba' zhig goms su gzhug /mnyam bzhag rjes thob zer ba de// langs 'dug gnyis la zer ba yin// dang po langs pa'i mnyam bzhag ni// dge ba'i dmigs pa gang rung la// rtse gcig mi g.yo sems brtan na// 'gro 'dug byas kyang mnyam bzhag yin// dmigs pa rtse gcig mi gnas par// rnam rtog gang dgar shor gyur na// mal du sgom kyang rjes thob yin// rang sems rtogs pa'i mnyam bzhag ni// rnal 'byor bzhi yi rim pas shes// rtse gcig rnal 'byor shar dus su// rang gi sems kyi rang bzhin rtogs// bar snang dag pa'i dkyil lta bu// gsal stong ma 'gags sal le ba// sing nge ye re 'dug pa de// rnal 'byor dang po'i mnyam bzhag yin// de las rnam rtog 'phros pa de// mal na sgom yang rjes thob yin// gsal stong sing nge yer re ba// gnas na lab bob 'gro 'dug kyang*// mnyam bzhag ngang la gnas pa yin// spros bral rnal 'byor shar dus su// rang gi sems kyi ngo bo rtogs// rig pa spros bral rgyun chad med// skye 'gag blang dor med pa yi// rang sems chos skur gnas pa de// rnal 'byor gnyis pa'i mnyam bzhag yin// mnyam bzhag de la gnas pa na// 'gro'am lab lob smra byed kyang*// mnyam bzhag ngang la gnas pa yin// spros pa'i mtshan mas g.yengs pas na// mal na sgom yang rjes thob yin// ro gcig rnal 'byor shar dus su// rang gi sems kyi mtshan nyid rtogs// rang sems spros bral chos sku las// 'khor 'das du mar shar ba rtogs// rnam par rtog dang mi rtog dang*// snang dang snang med gnas pa dang*// mi gnas stong dang mi stong dang*// gsal dang mi gsal sna tshogs kun// 'od gsal chos skur ro gcig pas// chos sku min pa'i (451)snang ma mthong*// 'od gsal min pa'i rtogs ma mthong*// de ltar ro mnyam rtogs pa de// yid kyis zin pa'i dus tshod de// rnal 'byor gsum pa'i mnyam bzhag yin// gnyug ma'i yid kyis zin gyur na// mchongs rgyug lab lob smra byed kyang*// mnyam bzhag ngang la gnas pa yin// gnyug ma'i yid dang bral gyur na// mal na sgom yang rjes thob yin// sgom med rnal 'byor shar dus su// rig pa'i ngo bo rten dang bral// rnal 'byor pa la bsgom rgyu med// sgom mkhan mi 'dug phyal bar song*// sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan gyi// sangs rgyas rang la tshang ngo zer// 'di rang yin par da bzod shes// phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub de// 'di rang yin par don thag chod// ye nas gnas pa'i dngos grub la// thob bo snyam pa'i rlom sems med// dran pas zin dang ma zin med// nyi ma 'od dang bcas pa yin// rnal 'byor mnyam bzhag 'ba' zhig yin// gnyis med mngon gyur de la zer// rtse gcig dus kyi rjes thob ni// dang po a 'thas nyid du snang*// snang yang sgyu mar bsgom par bya// spros bral dus kyi rjes thob ni// ras 'ga' sgyu mar snang yang ni// res 'ga' a 'thas nyid du snang*// snang yang chos skur bsgom par bya// ro gcig dus kyi rjes thob ni// dran pas zin tshe chos skur 'char// ma zin a 'thas yad yud tsam// sgom du med la mnyam bzhag dang*// rjes med chos sku 'ba' zhig yin// gzugs sku gnyis po nyams snang ngo*// smra khams che ba'i kha na med// phye gtor 'gam pa'i kha na med// rang mgo rang gis ma gtums shig

/sgom du med pa'i dus tshod ni// gnyid log ma log med par gsal// rtog dpyod byas rung ma byas rung*// dran pas zin rung ma zin rung*// bdag med gzhan med chos skur gsal// dmigs med thugs rje'i 'bad rtsol gyis// rnam rtog med par shugs kyis 'char// de 'dra'i dus la ma phyin bar// kha lta yug pa'i (452)sgom chen gyis// rang gis rang nyid bslus nyen che'o// de ltar skal ldan sgom chen rnams// sgom med pa la slebs kyi bar// bla ma bkur zhing bsod nams bsags// kha lta yug pos ma bslus na// bsod nams tshogs kyis bslus pa med// rtogs ldan rnams kyi snying gtam yin// tshogs dang dben pa'i khyad par ni// chos sku ye nas 'bral med cing*// gnyis 'dzin shes pa dang bral ba// chos brgyad phyogs su ma lhung na// tshogs su 'khyams rung dben pa yin// gnyis 'dzin zhen pa dang bcas pas// bde sdug la sogs yid byed na// dben sar bsdad kyang tshogs pa yin// de phyir dben dang tshogs kyang rung*// gnyis med rtogs dang ma bral bas// skyid sdug yid la mi byed pas// gang la'ang zhen pa mi byed ces// tshogs dang dben pa phye ba dang*// mnyam bzhag rjes sogs phye ba gnyis// las dang po yi gang zag rnams// drang phyir dgongs te gsungs pa yin// nges pa'i don la tshogs dben dang*// mnyam rjes la sogs gnyis su med// ci phyir zhe na sems nyid 'di// lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku// snang ba lhan skyes chos sku'i 'od// mar me dang mar me'i 'od bzhin no// rig pa chos sku'i ngo bo la// rgyun chad 'phel 'grib mi srid phyir// mnyam rjes la sogs ga la srid// de rtogs brtan pa'i sgom chen la// mnyam rjes la sogs su yis khags// de phyir gang zag tshod ma bzung*// nyams myong rtogs pa gang gces na// nyams myong mi gces rtogs pa gces// nyams myong ji ltar bzang gyur kyang*// rtogs pa med na grol mi srid// rtogs pa ji ltar mtho gyur kyang*// snying rje med na nyan thos lam// bsam gtan bzhi la sogs rnams la// nyams myong ting 'dzin yod mod kyi// rtogs pa med pa'i skyon chen gyis// nyams myong zad nas phyir la yang*// ngan song gsum sogs lhung nas ni// sdug bsngal mi bzad myong la ltos// nyams myong thams cad 'dus byas yin// (453)'dus byas thams cad mi rtag 'jig

/de phyir nyams la ma zhen par// gnyis med ye shes rtogs par gyis// mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa de// rtogs pa kho na'i spyod yul yin// blo yis byas pa'i gnyis med de// thos pa che bas rtogs 'gyur te// rtog pa kho na'i spyod yul yin// nang nas shar ba'i gnyis med 'di// bla ma'i byin rlabs 'ba' zhig yin// dpal ldan bla ma la gus te// nang nas rtogs pa'i nges shes skye// brtags dpyad mkhan la ci cha yod// tshig tu shes pa ngas kyang shes// rkyen ngan thub bam mi thub brtag /g.yas nas st+wa gris gshog byed cing*// mi snyan sna tshogs sgrog par byed// g.yon nas tsan dan dris mchod cing*// gus pas snyan pa sna tshogs sgrog /de 'dra'i bde sdug myong dus su// ched du bsran pa ma yin pas// bde sdug dga' min dgag med na// smyon spyod tshogs su phyung bas chog /'on kyang ma dad skur la sogs// nus pa thogs med ma thob bar// gsang bar bshad pa'i spyad pa rnams// tshogs su bshad na bdag gzhan brlag /gzhan don 'grub mi 'grub sogs kyi// mngon mkhyen sna tshogs shar ba dang*// nus pa thogs med thob gyur nas// gsang spyod tshogs spyod dbye ba med// rje btsun mi la'i zhal nas kyang*// dge bcu spyad du med par gda'// sdig bcu spang du med par gda'// ma bcos lhug par gnas par gda'// rje btsun lo ro'i zhal nas kyang*// mtho la gnyan pa'i dkon mchog gsum// bkur med rig pa'i ngang du rdzogs// skyabs 'gro bya ba ngas ma rnyed// rje btsun rnam pa'i dgongs pa de// zhang gi sprang ban bdag dang ni// rtogs ldan rdo rje'i spun rnams la// bum nang mar me bzhin du gsal// bshad na khyed kyis go ba dka'// dad ldan bla ma mnyes byed cing*// byin rlabs snying la zhugs pa yi// rang shar rnams kyi spyod yul yin// phyogs las rnam rgyal spyod pa sogs// gang gis dogs nas 'dir ma glengs// (454)rgya mtsho lta bu'i rgyud mchog ltos// bab col the tshom ma byed par// spyod pa dus dang 'brel bar gyis// sgrub pa thang lhod med par gyis// lta ba phyogs ris med par gyis// spyod pa tshul bcos med par gyis// sgom pa yengs pa med par gyis// yon tan zad pa med par 'byung*// 'gro don dpag tu med pa 'grub// gnyis med rtogs pas ma zin pa'i// btsan thabs bcos ma tho cho yin// dgra zin gser dang bong ba snyoms// ya tshul spyi tshis ma byas pas// grol na bu chung cis mi grol// gnyis med rtogs pas ma zin pa'i// gza' gtad med pas grol gyur na// smyon pa rnams kyang grol bar rigs// gnyis med rtogs pas ma zin pa'i// gtsang rtsog med pas grol gyur na// khyi phag rnams kyang grol bar rigs// gnyis med rtogs pas ma zin pa'i// spyod lam mkhas pas grol gyur na// bag ma rnams kyang grol bar rigs// gnyis med rtogs pas ma zin pa'i// rang byung lhug pas grol gyur na// glan glen rnams kyang grol bar rigs// gnyis med rtogs pas zin gyur na// spyod pa rtsing rung mi rtsing rung*// ji ltar byas kyang grol bar 'gyur// gnyis med rtogs pas ma zin na// zhib rung rtsing rung 'ching bar 'gyur// phyogs med snying rjes khyab gyur na// ji ltar byas kyang mchog gi lam// phyogs med snying rjes ma khyab na// ji ltar byas kyang dman pa'i lam//

spyod pa'i le'u'o/ ༈ /dam tshig ji ltar bsrung zhe na// dang po'i las pa'i dus tshod na// so sor thar pa'i sdom la sogs// bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' mi bcag /rtsa rlung sgom pa'i dus tshod na// bde drod mi mthun phyogs rnams spong*// gnyis med rdzogs pa shar dus na// ched du bya ba thams cad spang*// kun la rang sems dbang por bzhag /dbyings las mi 'da'i don rtogs nas// bsrung du med pa'i dam tshig mchog /dkar po cig thub bya ba yin// dam tshig gi le'u'o/ ༈ /lta ba phyin ci ma log cing*// gdams ngag nod tshogs ma 'chugs na// sgom pa ma nor thang lhod med// spyod pa mi nor zhen pa med// dam tshig lha yis ma khrel na// 'bras bu dgos 'dod gdon mi (455)za// dper na sman gyi sdong po zhig /zhing sa sa bon dus tshod dang*// chu lud rten 'brel rnams tshogs na// myu gus kyang ni nad sel na// sdong po yal ga lo 'dab dang*// me tog 'bras bu thams cad kyi// tshod ka tshod ka'i yon tan gyis// nad rnams sel ba ji bzhin no// log pa'i rten 'brel rnams kyis kyang*// 'bras bu sdug bsngal 'byin nus na// ma nor legs pa'i rten 'brel gyis// bde legs thams cad 'grub par nges// shin tu brtson ldan rnal 'byor pas// man ngag zab mos zin gyur na// gnyis med rtogs pa ma shar na// rnam shes gzhan gyi grong 'jug dang*// gong du 'pho ba'i sbyor ba yis// mngon sum nyid du 'grub par 'gyur// ma nus kyang ni bar dor 'char// rab kyi 'od gsal mngon du byed// mthong lam min zhes su zhig smod// nangs par nyi ma shar ma thag /chab rom zhu bar ma nus shing*// sa rdo dros par ma gyur kyang*// nyi ma min zhes su zhig smod// sa dang lam gyi khyad par dang*// drod rtags khyad par so so kun// rim 'jug gdul bya drang don du// thub pas ldem por gsungs pa la// rmongs rnams nyi tshe'i phyogs char zhen// gdul bya'i mtho dma' bsam mi khyab// sangs rgyas gsung rab bsam mi khyab// rang rang gzhung dang ma mthun yang*// smad cing spang bar mi bya zhing*// nam zhig go bar smon lam gdab// phyag rgya chen po chig chod la// pa na sa yi 'bras bu bzhin// rgyu dang 'bras bu dus mtshungs shing*// mtshan ma rang sar grol ba yin// spre'u rnams mas 'dzeg shing thog len// khwa tas yal ga ma mthong ste// shing thog len par smra ci yod// de bzhin gcig char gang zag gis// sa lam drod rtags ma mthong yang*// chos sku thob par smra ci yod// sbyangs dang nus pa so so yin// gnyug ma rtogs pa'i skad cig la// mya ngan 'das pa'i rgyal srid thob// thog med sems nyid dag pa 'di// 'bras bu yin pa da gdod shes// shes pa'am rtogs pa'i 'du shes med// 'bring (456)gis sgyu lus zung 'jug 'grub// tha mas mngal gyi grong khyer khegs// yang na gar skye rang dbang thob// de nas sku gsum gdon mi za// phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor pa// shes pa lhod kyis glod pa'i tshe// gsal la rtog med pa yi nyams// bar snang dag pa'i dkyil ltar 'char// de ltar 'char ba'i dus nyid du// sdig pa dpag med nges par 'dzad// nges pa'i shes pa ma skyes kyang*// chos kyi sku dang mjal ba yin// gnyis med lhan cig skyes pa yi// rtogs pa lhag gis shar ba yi// skad cig nyid la thog med nas// bsags pa'i sdig pa ji snyed rnams// ma lus gtan nas 'joms par byed// mun pa'i nang gi sgron me bzhin// phyag rgya chen po chig chod la// rmongs pas sa lam rtsis pas 'khrul// 'on kyang rmongs rnams dga' ba'i phyir// mtshan nyid theg pa'i sa lam rnams// 'dir yang dod po brtsi bar bya// rtogs pa lhag gis shar ba de// mthong lam rab tu dga' ba'i sa// ro mnyam rtogs pa de nyid la// goms par byed pa sgom pa'i lam// goms su med pa mthar phyin lam// gnyis med rtogs ma thag nyid du// sdug bsngal sangs par ma gyur cing*// yon tan nus pa ma skyes kyang*// rang grol mnyam rjes skye shi med// sku lnga lhun gyis grub pa yi// rdo rje 'chang chen nyid du grol// de lta bu yi mthun rkyen de// tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing sgrib gnyis sbyangs// byang ba'i stobs kyis thob par bshad// 'di yang tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa ste// sgrib pa gnyis kyang shugs kyis 'byongs// gnyis med rtogs pa'i skad cig la// bla ma sangs rgyas kun mnyes pas// bsod nams tshogs chen de ru rdzogs// ser sna rnam smin la sogs kyi// sgrib pa'i sa bon gtan nas byang*// rdzogs pa'i byang chub ces bya'o// phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub yin// e ma ho ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// skad cig nyid la rdzogs sangs rgyas/

/'bras bu'i (457 le'u'o/ ༈ /de ltar lta ba'i gnas lugs dang*// sgom pa'i spyod pa dam tshig dang*// 'bras bu la sogs chos rnams kun// rang gi sems kyi rnam 'phrul yin// sems nyid rang rig gsal ba'i ngang*// gsal ba nyid nas rang bzhin stong*// mkha' ltar ris su chad pa med// phyogs cha mtha' dbus ngos bzung med// de lta bu yi sems nyid la// blta bya lta byed gnyis med pas// lta ba med cing rtogs pa med// bsgom bya sgom byed gnyis med pas// sgom pa med cing ngos bzung med// goms bya goms byed gnyis med pas// goms pa med cing ma goms med// yengs bya yengs byed gnyis med pas// ma yengs med cing yengs pa'ang med// spyad rgyu spyod mkhan gnyis med pas// spyod pa med cing spyad pa'ang med// 'thob bya thob byed gnyis med pas// grub pa med cing thob pa med// nam mkha' stong pa'i dkyil lta bu// rgyu dang 'bras bu gnyis med pas// bskyed pa med cing smin pa'ang med// ye nas stong pa chos nyid la// sgrib pa med cing byang ba'ang med// sems med rig stong dbyer med las// ye shes med cing mi shes med// de ltar lta sgom spyod pa dang*// dam tshig dang ni 'bras bu rnams// sems nyid 'od gsal ngo bor ni// mnyam par shes pa'i sgom chen la// blta bya lta byed zhen med pas// zhen med lta ba'i rgyal po yin// bsgom bya sgom byed zhen med pas// zhen med sgom pa'i rgyal po yin// spyad bya spyod byed zhen med pas// zhen med spyod pa'i rgyal po yin// 'thob bya thob byed zhen med pas// zhen med 'bras bu'i rgyal po yin// mnyam pa nyid kyi le'u'o/ ༈ /rang sems rtogs pa'i skad cig la// dkar po'i yon tan ma lus pa// sgrub pa med par dus gcig rdzogs// sems nyid bar snang lta bu la// sku gsum ye nas lhun grub kyi// sangs (458)rgyas dkon mchog de ru rdzogs// sems nyid spros bral 'dod chags bral// dam chos dkon mchog de ru rdzogs// rang bzhin skye med phyir mi ldog

/dge 'dun dkon mchog de ru rdzogs// de ltar dkon mchog gsum po yang*// rang sems rig par rdzogs pas na// gzhan la skyabs su 'gro mi dgos// nges pa'i skyabs 'gro de ru rdzogs// sems nyid spros dang bral ba la// zhe 'dod rang bzhin ye med pas// smon pa byang sems de ru rdzogs// thams cad 'khrul par go ba yis// dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje shar// gzhan don lhun gyis grub pa yi// 'jug pa'i byang sems de ru rdzogs// sems nyid bar snang lta bu la// 'dzin chags kun dang bral bas na// sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin pa rdzogs// mtshan ma'i dri ma rnam dag pas// tshul khrims pha rol phyin pa rdzogs// stong pa nyid la mi skrag cing*// khong khro'i sa bon bcom pas na// bzod pa'i pha rol phyin pa rdzogs// rig stong rgyun chad med pa'i phyir// brtson 'grus pha rol phyin pa rdzogs// rtse gcig ye nas lhun grub pas// bsam gtan pha rol phyin pa rdzogs// log rtog mtshan ma rang grol bas// shes rab pha rol phyin pa rdzogs// cir snang grogs su shar ba yis// thabs chen bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs// gnyis su med pa'i don rtogs pas// ye shes tshogs chen de ru rdzogs// sems nyid bar snang lta bu la// lus kyi mtshan ma gtan med pas// bum pa'i dbang mchog de ru rdzogs// ngag gi dri ma ye dag pas// gsang ba'i dbang mchog de ru rdzogs// yid kyi dri ma ye dag pas// shes rab ye shes dbang mchog rdzogs// cha mnyam dri ma gnas med pas// bzhi pa'i dbang mchog de ru rdzogs// rang rig rang gsal go ma 'gags// sku mdog phyag mtshan cir yang snang*// bskyed rim mtha' dag de ru rdzogs// gsal la ngos bzung med pa yi// rdzogs pa'i rim pa de ru rdzogs// rang sems 'od gsal gnyis med du// (459)lhan cig rtogs pa mthong ba'i lam// rgyun chad med pa sgom pa'i lam// 'bad rtsol med pa mthar phyin lam// gar yang 'gag med drod rtags mchog

/sa lam drod rtags de ru rdzogs// cir yang ma yin chos kyi sku// cir yang snang ba sprul pa'i sku// cir yang chos skur longs spyod pas// 'bras bu sku gsum de ru rdzogs// rang rig bar snang lta bu la// phyogs ris med pas lta ba rdzogs// dmigs zhen med pas sgom pa rdzogs// blang dor med pas spyod pa rdzogs// nyams pa med pas dam tshig rdzogs// lhun gyis grub pas 'bras bu rdzogs// sems nyid 'od gsal stong pa la// snga phyi dus gsum phyogs cha med// ji srid bdag 'dzin yod kyi bar// lta sgom spyod 'bras dam tshig yod// las dang las kyi rnam smin yod// sdig spang bsod nams bsags pa gces// dkar po chig thub bstan pa'i le'u'o/ ༈ /zhang gi sprang ban bdag la ni// nye gnas chos kyi blo gros kyis// bskul nas rang gi sems nyid kyi// gnas lugs sgro skur ye med par// gdul bya 'ga' zhig drang ba'i phyir// sgro btags nas ni yi ger bkod// rkyen ngan cir yang snang ba'i phyir// brtse bas bris pas nyes pa med// dge ba 'di dang dge gzhan rnams// ma lus gcig tu gyur nas ni// nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam 'gro don du// gnyis med chos sku mngon gyur shog /'bad pa med pa'i 'gro don du// zhen bral dmigs med thugs rje yi// gzugs skus nam mkha'i mtha' khyab pas// gang 'dul de la de ston shog /deng nas brtsams te dus kun tu// dal 'byor phun sum tshogs thob nas// dad dang shes rab snying rje yis// stobs chen dge phyogs 'ba' zhig shog /kun tu rdo rje theg chen snod// rab gyur bla ma'i gdams ngag dang*// rtogs mchog thugs rje'i byin rlabs can// rnyed nas rtag tu mnyes byed shog /kun tu bla ma'i yon tan mthong*// skyon rnams (460)skad cig mi mthong bar// rdor 'dzin nyid du rtag mthong ste// dad gus rgyun chad med par shog /kun slong ngan pas ma sbags pa'i// dmigs med snying rje chen po yis// bla ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// yon tan ma lus bdag por shog

/rtag chad mu mtha' la sogs pa'i// phyogs bral lta ba rnam dag pa'i// zhen med bde gsal mi rtog dang*// ro snyoms spyod pa mchog thob shog /kun tu g.yo sgyu'i tshul 'chos dang*// nyon mongs dri mas ma gos pa'i// dam tshig mkha' 'gro ma khrel ba// srung zhing bsgrub la rtag brtson shog /rtag tu ri khrod 'grims byed cing*// 'jigs skyo bar chad gtan mi 'byung*// nyams myong rtogs pa drod rtags sogs// yon tan rdzu 'phrul mthu ldan shog /bdag gis spyod pa ci byas kun// bla ma kun dang mched kun dang*// sems can gzhan dag ma lus pa// kun gyi yid du 'ong bar shog /bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum dang*// gnas dang gos dang ming rus dang*// mthong thos dran reg la sogs kyis// gzhan phan 'dod pa kun rdzogs shog /dngos kun chags med gtong med cing*// re 'dod la sogs skyon dang bral// rnam dag khrims ldan sems mi 'khrugs// brtan spro mi g.yo mkha' rtogs shog /bskyed rdzogs gnyis la brtan thob nas// 'od gsal zung 'jug mthar phyin te// bdag gi byin rlabs lhun grub kyis// 'gro drug re ba skong bar shog /bdag gi dmigs med snying rje dang*// mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul dpag yas kyis// lha klu gnod sbyin bdud la sogs// mthu chen dregs pa kun 'dul shog /bdag gi mgo dang rkang lag dang*// sha khrag srog dbugs la sogs pa// gzhan phan dus la bab gyur na// spro zhing legs gtong mi 'gyod shog /zas skom bu nor bzhon pa sogs// longs spyod sna tshogs gang 'dod la// bdag gis ci 'dod zad med kyi// phan thogs nga rgyal med par shog /dgra dang gdon gyis gang nyen dang*// nad dang mu ge la sogs (461)pa'i// sdug bsngal gang gis nyen pa rnams// bdag gi mthu dpal gyis skyob shog /deng nas brtsams te dus kun tu// gzhan don 'ba' zhig spyod byed cing*// gzhan gyis mi rigs gang byas la// yid 'khrugs skyo med phan thogs shog

/rlom sems nga rgyal phrag dog dang*// rang 'dod nye ring phyogs ris sogs// mi dge'i dri mas ma gos par// 'gro ba kun la phan thogs shog /gzhan gyis bstod sogs dga' ba med// smad sogs skyon la mi dga' med// 'bad med btang snyoms snying rje yis// chags sdang dri mas ma gos shog /spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs rje dang*// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi shes rab dang*// phyag na rdo rje'i mthu stobs rnams// ma lus bdag la rdzogs par shog /klu sgrub snying po'i mkhyen pa dang*// sa ra ha yi rtogs pa dang*// bir wa pa yi nus mthu rnams// ma lus bdag gis thob par shog /sngags rgyud ma lus sbyor ba shes// las tshogs mtha' dag thogs med 'grub// man ngag dpag med mnga' bdag byed// mkha' 'gro ma lus mnyes byed shog /chos kun gang nas ma 'ong zhing*// gang du yang ni mi 'gro la// gar yang mi gnas mnyam pa'i don// nges rtogs rab brtan gzhan phan shog /zhe 'dod skyon bral gzhan don du// bzo dang bstan bcos thams cad dang*// snyan dngags la sogs phyogs med mkhas// rgol ba kun gyis mi thub shog /rigs dang yon tan la spyod dang*// ma nor tshig don shes rab dang*// mthu rtsal spobs pa la sogs pa// mthun rkyen tshogs kyis mi phongs shog / smon lam gyi le'u'o/ ༈ /deng sang dus na chos pa rnams// tshig tshogs mkhas kyang don ma rtogs// spyir yang rgyal rtsod pa 'phel// sgrub brgyud bla ma rje btsun rnams// don gyi rjes su 'brangs te sgrub// nga rgyal la sogs gtan spangs te// don rtogs lung rigs dgongs pa rdzogs// (462)tai lo pas ni nā ro la// tshig gcig tsam yang ma gsungs te// lung rigs man ngag thams cad kun// ma lus nā ro'i thugs la rdzogs// de phyir kho bo'i lab lob 'di// sengs bskyungs la sogs sbyangs pa dang*// 'gal 'brel rtsis na zlos pa'i skyon// ma brtags mu cor smras pa yin// rang gi gdul byar babs pa la// 'dis mi phan pa srid pa'i mtha'// mi khegs snyam nas bris pa yin// lung rigs gdams dang ma mthun pa// tshig gcig byung na mgo bo khos// sprang ban zhang gi rtogs tshod 'di// spang bu thul gyi brag sngon du// nye gnas mar pas bskul nas bris// phyi ma la bsten sdig pa gsog
/bka' dang bstan bcos rnams dang ni// bla ma dam pa'i dgongs pa dang*// rang gi rtogs tshogs glengs pa yin// gu hya sa ma ya/// /
